name: Form Sterilizer
implementation_notes: Mirrors FormCpoDispatchView.vue's structural pattern (breadcrumb + hamburger header, sectioned form body, dirty-tracking Back confirm, Pause/Clear/Simpan footer actions) but WITHOUT the grid/N-column/time-slot-uniqueness concept AND without a per-row event_date column — Log Siklus is a free event log, rows added manually via 'Tambah baris' with no upper bound, all rows sharing the header's single Date

Duration (Minutes) computed client-side (open_door_time - close_door_time, wrapping across midnight) via the exported computeDurationMinutes() helper in sterilizerRecordRepo.ts, reused identically by both FormSterilizerView.vue (live preview, rendered as a disabled/non-editable <input> showing the computed value) and the repo's own applyDetailRowChanges() (value persisted locally) — but the SERVER (SterilizerRecordService::computeDurationMinutes()) always recomputes and overrides this value on save/update, never trusting the client-persisted one, per entity-catalog: duration_minutes 'BUKAN kolom yang diinput user secara langsung'

Hapus baris follows the queue-for-deletion pattern (a row with an existing id is queued in pendingDeletionIds, only actually DELETEd by the repo on the next Simpan/Pause call) — consistent with Form CPO Dispatch/Kernel Dispatch/Solid Waste Disposal

checked_by_spv rendered as a plain <input type="checkbox"> bound via v-model per row — a simple boolean, never disabled/role-gated (unlike the header's Checked By/Acknowledged By, which ARE role-gated to supervisor/mill_management respectively)

8 time-type detail fields (close_door_time, peak_1_time, exhaust_1_time, peak_2_time, exhaust_2_time, peak_3_time, exhaust_3_time, open_door_time) all rendered as <input type="time"> — only close_door_time and open_door_time carry data-testid selectors (the two fields the Duration computation and its tests depend on), the other 6 are plain, matching CPO Dispatch's convention of only tagging fields with test-relevant behavior
This is the FINAL station of this project (18th and last of the 18 canonical stations, promoted 2026-09-01)

known_issues.description: Browser/E2E test not generated for this pass — component-level (Vitest) coverage exercises save/pause/clear/back flows instead.
